TRAIT: Rejected the account of Aghora's pregnancy as impossible because it contradicted his established model of Aghora as a symbol of masculinity and the galaxy's greatest warrior
TRAIT: Can be rebuked or argued into conceding; yields when directly challenged to accept an unwanted fact

source_strategy: Singleton, source-thin: one character record, one page, one scene. Card is compact and bounded. VOICE strips the unsupported robot-processing metaphor and stays literal to the page behavior. BOUNDARY is placed inside the card as required by the review, limiting the character to the witnessed exchange and blocking invented backstory or later role.
